basis: Independent direct opens of the two durable original PNGs before any drawing. The monochrome scans do not establish actual pigment colours, numerical optical data, or measured distances.

inventory.description: One perspective interior: ceiling with parallel board strokes; a left window/shutter; rear wall and central double door/cabinet; floorboards; table and stools/chairs; a lower-right book-like stack; a right wall receiving the spectrum. These are scene/support structure, not a calibrated grid or counted data table.
inventory.modernTreatment: Simplify interior to a room/window/receiving-wall outline and a prism support; omit clutter and wood-grain strokes. Keep the dark-room/window-to-opposite-wall meaning.

inventory.description: One narrow beam travels from a small aperture in the left window downward/right toward one central prism above the support. The aperture is round in the bound lesson prose. No source point names, dimension labels, numerical angle, or direction arrow labels are present.
relationships: window aperture precedes prism
incident beam is narrow
beam enters only one prism

inventory.description: One glass-prism shape at the incident-beam end, supported on the central table/stand. It turns the beam into an upward/right-spreading fan; its drawn orientation is not the apex-up arrangement of fig-197.
relationships: incident beam meets prism
emerging fan starts at the prism
one prism only

inventory.description: The emerging fan terminates at an elongated vertical sequence of partially overlapping round/elliptical patches on the right receiving surface. Several dark and light boundaries merge in this black-and-white scan. Seven named colours are supplied by the frozen prose, not legible pigment or text in the pixels.
relationships: each fan path reaches the same receiving wall
round-hole images partly overlap
elongated spectrum rather than a single undispersed spot
inventory.modernTreatment: Seven representative overlapping circles and English colour names make the frozen prose inspectable. These are representative colour-name samples, not a claim that the continuous solar spectrum has only seven discrete components. Use only semantic vector colour roles.

inventory.description: Left opaque vertical barrier interrupted at one aperture; one vertical biconvex lens immediately to its right; one triangular hatched prism farther right; one vertical receiving screen at far right. The prose identifies the aperture as a narrow illuminated slit. Source apparatus order is slit, lens, prism, screen.
relationships: one lens only
one prism only
one receiving screen
slit before lens before prism before screen

inventory.description: Two oblique solid rays leave the slit toward the upper and lower parts of the lens, with rightward arrows. A third, horizontal central line runs from the slit toward the screen. After the lens the upper ray slopes slightly downward and the lower ray upward, toward the undispersed image.
relationships: upper and lower rays share the slit
upper/lower rays meet opposite parts of the same lens
central line joins slit and undispersed screen position

inventory.description: Dashed upper and lower continuations from behind the lens converge at a common upper screen position on the central line. They distinguish the no-prism white slit-image reference from the solid dispersed paths.
relationships: both dashed reference paths converge at one screen location
their starts align with upper and lower lens rays
inventory.modernTreatment: English 'White image' labels the source dashed reference. It is explicitly a reference, not an additional source, second prism, or recombination experiment.

inventory.description: Apex-up triangular prism with horizontal base, schematically shaded by oblique hatch strokes. Solid paths enter the two prism faces and emerge toward two lower screen positions. The upper lens route meets near the apex; the lower route meets the left face and crosses the prism to the right face. Rightward arrows appear on the emerging rays.
relationships: solid paths are continuous through prism entry and exit
two representative colour bundles each meet a common image point on the screen
red screen position is above violet
both dispersed images lie below the no-prism reference

inventory.description: Exactly two printed colour words appear next to the right screen: red (Chinese source label) beside the upper dispersed image and violet (Chinese source label) beside the lower one. relationships: Red is associated with the upper solid-ray screen contact
